title: Algonquin and Arrowhead
subtitle: An autumn road trip through market streets, colourful forest trails and still lakes.

cover.alt: A river bend surrounded by red, gold and green autumn forest.
cover.caption: A river bend surrounded by red, gold and green autumn forest.

chapters.title: A stop in Orillia
paragraphs: Shopfronts and market shelves begin the road trip. Beyond town, the route passes autumn water and ends with a meal.

chapters.title: Autumn at Arrowhead
paragraphs: Gold and red leaves line the roads, trails and water. The walk follows forest paths, rocky water and a bridge among the autumn trees.

chapters.title: Towards Algonquin
paragraphs: The road continues to the Algonquin visitor centre. Cloudy lake views, reflections and a rack of canoes finish the autumn outing.
